comment: Map stock secureblue issues to Unwoke-only, revertable ujust. Never applied to a bake. Skip if it cannot hit Silverblue/Kinoite overlay or we have no allowlisted revert.

bluetooth.note: Stock only loads BT modules. We also mask the service and rfkill. Wi-Fi is not touched.

camera.note: Capture is locked here by default. Speakers stay. Browser policy is a second door: ujust set-brave-devices off if needed.

xwayland.note: Stock command. Security degradation. Prefer a Wayland app.

flathub.note: There is no Bazaar. Verified remote only unless you mean ujust set-flathub full.

brew.note: New shell after. Stock ships brew on PATH; we do not.

toolbox.note: Wrappers until you opt in. Then stock distrobox-assemble works. podman stays.

userns.note: Stock command. Needed for Distrobox/Podman. Security degradation.

unconfined-userns.note: Stock command. Other browsers / Electron / bubblejail. Security degradation.

jit.note: Origin and *-trivalent. Restart the browser. One site is not a reason to flatten every pack.

devices.note: Site camera/mic/USB/geo. Restart the browser. Also ujust set-camera-mic on for the hardware lock.

vpn.code:
ujust install-proton
# or: ujust install-ivpn
# or: ujust install-mullvad
vpn.revert: Remove the WireGuard connection in Network settings. Do not leave an RPM origin you did not want.
vpn.note: WireGuard import first. No Snap, no store. Official app only after checksum/gpg and an asked extra origin.

usb.revert: Follow their docs to disable USBGuard. That is weaker.
usb.note: Stock command. Allow what is plugged in now.

vm.note: SPICE/clipboard on a secureblue guest often needs Xwayland. Do not setenforce 0.

nvidia.revert: Rebase back to the non-NVIDIA Unwoke name you were on.
nvidia.note: Use an Unwoke *-nvidia-open image, not stock's. Then first-boot signed origin. Not Ventoy.

nags.note: We mask some stock user units. This turns those nags back on. Our signed-reboot nag is separate.

trivalent.code:
ujust set-brave-jitless off
ujust set-brave-isolation off
ujust set-brave-devices off
# one line at a time, then restart Trivalent
trivalent.revert:
ujust set-brave-jitless on
ujust set-brave-isolation on
ujust set-brave-devices on
trivalent.note: Our extra policies on *-trivalent (same packs as Origin). Try the one that matches the symptom: JIT for broken JS, isolation for WebGL/WebGPU, devices for site camera/mic. If none of that is the bug, it is stock Trivalent — wait for their signed image. We do not patch Chromium. Do not Bubblejail Trivalent.
